# rollout

> Durable, scalable agents and environments for agent products and reinforcement learning. A uv workspace of Python
> 3.13 packages: `rollout` (tasks, agents, programs, a loop that runs episodes), `rollout-train` (rollout jobs,
> episodes with token trajectories, the training loop, policies, channels, the recorder, deployment profiles, the
> `rollout` command), one package per implementation (a durable runner, a vLLM engine, a LoRA trainer, Qwen and
> Gemma renderers, computers, an OpenAI endpoint, an S3 blob store), two products and one environment. The
> documentation describes the code as built.

Conventions: hooks and tools are `async`; everything leaving task or agent code goes through `run`; contract types
are frozen pydantic models; type names are never abbreviated. In the guide, a block tagged exactly `python` runs in
the test suite and a block tagged `python fragment` does not. The API reference is generated from the source.

## Guide

- [Guide index](docs/guide/README.md): the pages, the concepts, where each name lives
- [Three ways in](docs/guide/perspectives.md): the surface for building an environment, for designing training,
  and for deploying
- [Getting started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): install, a first task, one episode against a scripted model
- [Tasks](docs/guide/tasks.md): hooks, observations, endings, validation rules, rewards, more model slots
- [Tools](docs/guide/tools.md): `@tool` methods, schemas from type hints, results, errors as observations, imported
  tool sets
- [Agents](docs/guide/agents.md): context selection, context hints, acting, the `Model` interface
- [Conversations](docs/guide/conversations.md): `WaitFor`, message kinds, priorities, queue / steer / interrupt
- [Content](docs/guide/content.md): messages, blocks, tool results, blobs (files or S3), digests
- [Runs and events](docs/guide/runs-and-events.md): `LocalRunContext`, effect identity, run events, the local runner
- [Models](docs/guide/models.md): binding model slots to the Responses API adapter; Codex login or API key
- [Testing](docs/guide/testing.md): `ScriptedModelEndpoint` and helpers
- [Deploying](docs/guide/deploying.md): the profile file and the `rollout` command
- [API reference](docs/guide/reference.md): every public name, by module, with signatures, fields and docstrings

## Architecture

- [Overview](docs/architecture/overview.md): layers, protocols and their implementations, visibility, a turn
- [Glossary](docs/architecture/glossary.md): every term, defined once

## Libraries

- [Harness](docs/libraries/rollout/README.md): the loop, programs, runners, message routing, failures
- [Determinism](docs/libraries/rollout/determinism.md): what code a durable runner replays must do
- [Hooks](docs/libraries/rollout/hooks.md): observers of every run's events and model samples
- [Memory](docs/libraries/rollout/memory.md): a context that fits any model, for long episodes
- [Contracts](docs/libraries/rollout/contracts/README.md): the types that cross layers:
  [identifiers](docs/libraries/rollout/contracts/identifiers.md),
  [canonical content](docs/libraries/rollout/contracts/canonical-content.md),
  [run events](docs/libraries/rollout/contracts/run-events.md), [effects](docs/libraries/rollout/contracts/effects.md),
  the [model endpoint](docs/libraries/rollout/contracts/model-endpoint.md)
- [Rollouts](docs/libraries/rollout-train/rollouts.md): jobs, tickets, the stream of episodes, publishing weights
- [Policies and the ledger](docs/libraries/rollout-train/policies.md): policy versions, manifests, append-only
  tables and fences
- [Episodes](docs/libraries/rollout-train/episodes.md): what a finished run carries for training
- [Training](docs/libraries/rollout-train/training.md): the loop, its steps over groups, group-relative advantages,
  the curriculum, the trainer protocol
- [Channels](docs/libraries/rollout-train/channels.md) and the [recorder](docs/libraries/rollout-train/recorder.md):
  engines, limits, publishing weights, token recording
- [The recorder over HTTP](docs/libraries/rollout-train/harness-endpoint.md): the OpenAI-compatible endpoint for
  harnesses that bring their own loop
- [Monitor](docs/libraries/rollout-train/monitor.md): a live page over a run's directory: its steps, groups,
  episodes and every agent's turns

## Implementations

- [Durable runner](docs/implementations/rollout-durable/README.md): runs that survive their process;
  [evicting idle runs](docs/implementations/rollout-durable/eviction.md),
  [several runners](docs/implementations/rollout-durable/runners.md) on one Postgres
- [vLLM engine](docs/implementations/rollout-vllm.md), [LoRA trainer](docs/implementations/rollout-lora.md),
  [Qwen renderers](docs/implementations/rollout-qwen.md), [Gemma renderers](docs/implementations/rollout-gemma.md):
  what a profile names
- [Computers](docs/implementations/rollout-computers.md): environment backends and shell and file tools

## Products and environments

- [Project assistant](docs/products/project-assistant.md), [agent sessions](docs/products/agent-sessions.md)
- [Minecraft team](docs/products/minecraft-team.md): one to four agents in a Minecraft world, trained on a curriculum

## Everything else

- [Local services](docs/development/local-services.md): Postgres and an S3-compatible store for a development
  machine
